title: kate-core: complete a word in either ASCII case
summary: A lower prefix matches a word with a capital letter. The suffix is the rest of that word. The test goes in the existing completion tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: completion.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add has_ascii_prefix. The body walks the prefix with one all call. let mut chars = word.chars(); then prefix.chars().all with let Some(next) = chars.next() else { return false; }; and next.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&ch). Do not match Option by hand. In matches_between, replace word.starts_with(prefix) with one condition: has_ascii_prefix(&word, prefix) && seen.insert(word.clone()). Do not nest an if inside an if. In completion_suffix keep let word = word_completions(buf, at, 1).into_iter().next()?; Replace strip_prefix with let prefix_len = prefix.chars().count(); let suffix: String = word.chars().skip(prefix_len).collect(); if suffix.is_empty() { return None; }. Compare the tail with suffix.as_str(). Return Some(suffix). Do not touch is_word_char, rewind_word, forward_word, or word_completions. The existing test prefix_lists_later_words_once stays green. The test a_capital_word_completes_a_lower_prefix uses TextBuffer::from_str of Don't, space, don. word_completions at Offset(9) with limit 4 returns a vector whose one item is Don't. completion_suffix at Offset(9) returns Some("'t"). Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: completion::tests::a_capital_word_completes_a_lower_prefix
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. The list at the end of Don't don is empty. After the change the one item is Don't and the suffix is 't. The typed prefix don is already removed.
